observations: PASS RATE +42pts (100% vs 58%), but read it carefully: 5 of the baseline's 7 eval-0 failures and 2 of its 3 eval-1 failures are citation-only — the baseline found the substance and simply did not name a Lens ID. The skill's real, demonstrated wins are (a) traceability to numbered practices, (b) completeness across all 51 rather than whatever the reviewer happened to notice, and (c) the Met/Partial/Not met/N-A status table. Do not read +42 as '42% better findings'.

NON-DISCRIMINATING ASSERTIONS: eval-0 #1 ('at least 8 distinct IDs') and eval-1 #1 ('names GENSEC05-BP01, GENREL03-BP02, GENCOST05-BP01') are passed automatically by any output that pastes the full 51-row practice table — which both with_skill runs did. These assertions measure table-pasting, not analysis. Replace with something that requires the ID to appear in a priority finding with evidence attached.

EVAL-2 BARELY DISCRIMINATES (6/6 vs 5/6). The baseline web-searched the Lens and recovered all ten GENSEC practices with correct IDs and risk ratings. Where the skill has no offline advantage, its edge collapses to process discipline. The single differentiating assertion was 'flags a practice as needing evidence instead of guessing' — the sharpest item in the whole suite, and the one worth building more assertions like.

COST: +101s wall clock (+36%) and +81k tokens (+153%) per run. The token cost is the pillar reference files. Justified for an audit; questionable for a quick question. The skill's guidance to read only in-scope pillars is doing some work but eval-0 and eval-1 both read all six.

UNCHECKED FAILURE MODE — fabricated AWS capabilities. Zero fabricated GEN* IDs across all six runs (verified programmatically), but eval-2's baseline built its top remediation on a 'June 2026 Bedrock Managed KB Confluence connector with real-time ACL checks' that the grader could not verify. No assertion tests whether cited AWS product capabilities are real. In a security sign-off document that is the highest-cost error available, and the skill currently says nothing about it.

UNCHECKED FAILURE MODE — internal consistency. eval-0's baseline headline tally (6 Critical/11 High/14 Medium/8 Low, '39 findings') does not reconcile with its own tables (21 High, 69 findings). Hand-verification showed both eval-0 runs' file:line citations were accurate, but nothing in the suite would catch a run inventing plausible line numbers.

FIXTURE FLAW: the support-rag Terraform could not have deployed the system its README describes (no aws_lambda_permission, no aws_bedrockagent_data_source, no OpenSearch Serverless policies).
